about_the_game:
▼ A Brand-New Sensation in Rhythm Action, Conducted by Thighs! ▼

Master simple controls to command a pair of lovely thighs and vanquish the souls approaching from the back of the screen! Catch and purify souls to the upbeat rhythm... "MOMO Crash" is an exhilarating rhythm game with a novel theme like no other!

▼Personalities on Full Blast! Three "Thigh Warriors" Await!▼

In a world of chaos, they are the "Thigh-Warriors," the sole wielders of the power of purification. Look forward to their cute and powerful exploits!

💎 Daia (The Confident and Unstoppable Eternal Diamond High-Teen)

"Fascinate, Pierce, Dominate——The Perfectly Self-Produced Thighs"

Daia, the "Jewel Girl" who shines with confidence and style! To her, "KAWAII" (cuteness) is justice and the ultimate form of self-expression. Wielding her perfectly toned "Thighs" as weapons, she fights and dazzles day in and day out to paint the world in her unique vision of "KAWAII"! Her goal: to become the president of the No.1 brand. No one can stop her ambition!

💜 Seika (The Bashful, Heart-Fluttering, Philanthropic Sister with a Locked-Up Heart)

"Wanting to be saved, wanting to save——Thighs like a Cage of Love Swirling Within"

Seika is a shy sister torn between her duties in her sacred role and her earnest desire to be needed by someone. Hidden beneath her modest sister's attire, her "Thighs" hold a benevolent power to heal the world, and a "Cage of Love" concealing passions so fierce they sometimes threaten to imprison her. With those legs, what will she grasp? World peace, or her own small measure of happiness——?

🌞 Hikaru (The Wild, Sparkling, Optimistic Traveler with an Explosive Smile)

"Zero Guilt in Destruction——The Naive Hyper-Crush Thighs"

"I want to make everyone smile!" With this pure wish as her sole guide, the innocent traveler Hikaru journeys the world! To find her missing sister, she heroically CRUSHES any obstacle with her prized "Reinforced Thighs"! Bright as the sun, her destructive power comes with absolutely no ill-will or guilt, of course!

▼Easy for anyone! Core gameplay explained!▼

The controls are simple: just two actions—Clamp and Kick!

Three different types of targets fly in to the rhythm, and it’s up to you to respond with the right move!

But that’s not all—this game also features a Story Mode, where you can experience the epic tales of the Thigh Warriors.

Progress through the story to unlock new tracks, then play them in rhythm game to deepen your bond with the characters.

Your performance strengthens your relationships and even influences how the story unfolds.

Enjoy both “Thighs × Rhythm Game”, and save the world together with your favorite character!



👻 Flying "Souls" should be gently caught and held between the thighs
at the right moment to be purified!

🦠 But the "Viruses" that sometimes sneak in must be repelled with
a sharp Kick & Crush of the thighs to the beat!

🐈 And watch out for the cute "Cats" that occasionally appear...
you must never attack them by mistake!
Gently offer them your lap and let them rest until they're satisfied.

"Catch to Purify + Kick to Destroy + And Occasionally, Pet a Cat (?)" — This simple, yet profound, set of actions says it all...!

▼From the creators, with all our love (and thighs)▼

The SKOOTA GAMES team has fully embraced this universal human fetish—no, culture.

Thighs. A symbol of tenderness and strength.

With everything we’ve got… we present our thighs to you.
